title: Identify a symptom
prompt: What symptom did the speaker mention first?
hint: Give the first symptom in one word.

ja.prompt: 話し手が最初に言った症状は何ですか？
ja.hint: 最初に出てきた症状を一語で答えてください。

local.prompt: 说话者最先提到的症状是什么？
local.hint: 用一个词回答第一个症状。

local_pron.prompt: shuōhuà zhě zuì xiān tí dào de zhèngzhuàng shì shénme?
local_pron.hint: yòng yī gè cí huí dá dì yī gè zhèngzhuàng.

zh.prompt: 說話者最先提到的症狀是什麼？
zh.hint: 用一個詞回答第一個症狀。

en.prompt: What symptom did the speaker mention first?
en.hint: Give the first symptom in one word.

en_pron.prompt: wut SIM-tuhm did thuh SPEE-ker men-shuhn furst?
en_pron.hint: gayv thuh furst SIM-tuhm in wuhn werd.

title: Say what happened last night
hint: Use a short sentence: say you were shivering.

ja.prompt: 昨夜何が起きましたか？
ja.hint: 短い文で：寒気がしたと言いましょう。

local_pron.prompt: zuó wǎn fā shēng le shénme?
local_pron.hint: yòng duǎn jù shuō: nǐ zài fā dǒu.

en.hint: Use a short sentence: say you were shivering.

en_pron.hint: yooz uh short SEN-tens: say yoo wur SHIV-er-ing.

title: Duration of the symptoms
prompt: How long have the symptoms lasted?
hint: Answer: "They have lasted for several days."
sample: They have lasted for several days.

ja.prompt: 症状はどのくらい続いていますか？
ja.hint: 「それらは数日間続いています」と答えてください。
ja.sample: それらは数日間続いています。

local.hint: 回答：「它們已經持續了好幾天。」
local.sample: 它們已經持續了好幾天。

local_pron.hint: huídá: 'tāmen yǐjīng chíxù le hǎo jǐ tiān.'
local_pron.sample: tāmen yǐjīng chíxù le hǎo jǐ tiān.

zh.hint: 回答：「它们已经持续了好几天。」
zh.sample: 它们已经持续了好几天。

en.prompt: How long have the symptoms lasted?
en.hint: Answer: "They have lasted for several days."
en.sample: They have lasted for several days.

en_pron.prompt: how long hav thuh SIM-tuhmz LAST-ed?
en_pron.hint: AN-sər: 'They hav LAST-ed for SEV-er-al days.'
en_pron.sample: They hav LAST-ed for SEV-er-al days.
